people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Ramoth
people.line: City of refuge east of the Jordan

people.name: Tabor_Mount
people.line: Mountain in Israel, site of Deborah and Barak's victory

translations.web: “Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.
translations.bsb: “Hear this, O priests! Take heed, O house of Israel! Give ear, O royal house! For this judgment is against you because you have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.
translations.kjv: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
translations.asv: Hear this, O ye priests, and hearken, O house of Israel, and give ear, O house of the king; for unto you pertaineth the judgment; for ye have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
